REVIEW_VERDICT=approve | Q1=ok Q2=ok Q3=ok Q4=ok | The logic is sound and introduces no fail-open vulnerabilities. 
(Q1) An invalid receipt still fails because its directory exists, bypassing the new missing-directory check. Two-parent or empty-diff cars fail closed earlier in A2 prior to this check. The event name cannot be spoofed by a PR author on pull_request_target, and the PR number resolution on merge_group is safely executed via regex and explicitly checked for validity (exiting 2 if not matched).
(Q2) The PR-event path is unchanged because the added condition strictly requires GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=merge_group. Branch events fall through to the existing [ ! -d "$root/$pr" ] check and return 1 (RED) exactly as before.
(Q3) The three new test rows strictly exercise both polarities: dropping the event test causes 3 existing rows asserting RED on branch events to incorrectly return 0 (turning them RED/failing in test); dropping the return 0 causes the new neutral row to fall through and return 1 (turning it RED). The row-count derivation script (check_pr_review_counts.sh) runs successfully and correctly parses the 26 rows.
(Q4) No other defects or syntax errors were found. The outputs correctly flow to stdout for a successful/neutral validation.

REVIEW_VERDICT=approve | Q1=ok Q2=ok Q3=ok Q4=ok | Commit f28fff64 cleanly and safely introduces NEUTRAL handling on merge_group cars when a PR has no receipt directory, eliminating spurious queue failures while remaining strictly fail-closed.
- Q1 (Fail-open): ok. A PR with an existing receipt directory is unaffected and still fully validated against patch-id, legacy, A3 corruption control, and A4 signature verification. Multi-parent and empty-diff queue subjects fail closed (A2 parent count and patch-id checks) prior to reaching the neutral branch. GITHUB_EVENT_NAME is runner-controlled in pull_request_target (evaluated from the base repository) and cannot be spoofed by a PR author, nor can setting PR_REVIEW_SUBJECT_KIND=queue trigger neutral. On merge_group, PR number resolution is validated against regex; if absent, receipt presence was already required and enforced on the PR event.
- Q2 (PR-event path unchanged): ok. On pull_request_target, GITHUB_EVENT_NAME != merge_group, bypassing the neutral return and falling through directly to the preexisting `[ ! -d "$root/$pr" ]` check which returns 1 (RED).
- Q3 (Test rows and count consistency): ok. The 3 new fixture rows (queue-no-receipt-neutral, no-receipt-kind-queue, queue-no-receipt-merge) test both polarities of the event condition and queue commit structure. Dropping the event check, dropping the parent check, or dropping the return statement causes self-test rows to fail. The row count derivation in check_pr_review_counts.sh (derive_arm4_rows) matches the updated 26-row step name in .github/workflows/pr-review-quorum.yml.
- Q4 (Other defects): ok. No defects identified; bash syntax, safe variable expansions (${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:-} under set -u), and diagnostic outputs are clean and correct.

REVIEW_VERDICT=approve | Q1=ok Q2=ok Q3=ok Q4=ok | Commit f28fff64 cleanly implements NEUTRAL exit on merge_group queue cars when no receipt directory is present on the PR. The PR-event path remains strictly RED on missing receipts. All four questions (Q1-Q4) verified ok with no fail-open defects, robust polarities, and consistent count derivations.
